title: The number of holds outside the Vale is stated inconsistently across the game's own text: the Act 1 intro says 'the roads open: six holds'; Herald Corvane explicitly lists exactly six (Fenmarch, Thornwold, Iron Downs, Wardmoor, Saltkerns, Hollowbrook); the Act 2 status screen says 'Seven holds, seven unrested griefs' and names a 7th (Emberfall) that the herald never mentions; and the gray priest, moments after the Vale is settled, says 'There are five more hollows in the Reach.' Three different counts (5, 6, 7) appear for what should be one fixed number.
where: Act 1 intro / Herald Corvane dialogue / Act 2 status screen / gray priest dialogue
